about: Labelled cases: a deck and a memo with planted fabrications, checked against a short fact sheet. `expect` lists what must be flagged; `clean` lists claim text that must not be. `model` entries are only scored when the model runs.

cases.name: deck: bike-share annual update

expect.text: The repair backlog is now below weekly capacity
Riders keep coming back because the stations sit beside daily commute routes

clean: Repair backlog at 1.4x capacity, down from 2.1x
Two thirds of new docks are going here.
Confirm Q3 maintenance window by 15 March.

cases.name: memo: planted fabrications

expect.text: Eight of our 24 stations sit on hills.
Repair turnaround improved 33% in two years.

clean: Fare revenue reached $2.4M, up 42% year over year.
Two thirds of new docks go to the east bank.
Please confirm Q3 maintenance window by 15 March.
